title: Sycophancy Under Temporal Pressure: Urgency Framing

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Informative: urgency framing as a low-cost attack vector on model honesty is a practical concern. If it reliably increases sycophancy, this informs both adversarial threat modeling and evaluation design. Incremental but actionable.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Simple prompt-level experiment: add urgency framing to sycophancy probes and compare with baseline. API-based, minimal technical skill required. Measuring reasoning length as a secondary signal adds a small analysis step.
